svg.text: F09 the whole delay line: capture_local -> early_clk
iso0, iso1 buffer the capture edge into launch. MP/MN/MC/MCT: the current-starved stage of F08 (ua[0] sets how fast slow falls).
XR0-XR2 square the slow ramp back into a sharp edge: early_clk, which clocks the early observer a time d after capture.
Rails: VDD at the top, VSS at the bottom; every PMOS body is on VDD and every NMOS body on VSS (drawn inside the symbol). A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
